snippet.title: Black Flame Tactics Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A dark fantasy autobattler roguelike. Build your party and lead it to the bottom of the world, where the Black Flame burns. Every run brings new heroes, relics, mysterious events, bosses, ancient pacts and more. Brave the descent solo or with a friend in online co-op.

Coming to PC and Switch in 2027.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3382760
